integrity: The infinite theorem rests on symbolic prefix-extrema and sliding-window arguments; finite standalone tests are independent diagnostics, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for b >= 3 and n=b^k. No claim about arbitrary lengths or all automatic words. Potential equivalent results in broader morphic-balance literature have not been excluded by a full-text census.
title: Exact substitution-scale Abelian complexity of complementary binary morphic words
